pages.title: A field guide
The field guide
pages.text: This is a working guide to the frontier. Its chapters fill when you find something worth recording. Browse the categories to read your discoveries. The Unwritten pages entry offers hints for the trails still ahead.

pages.title: The field guide
pages.text: The last page of this chapter records your current expedition.

pages.title: Begin at the roots
pages.text: Look for pale growth and its ember-lit heart. Harvest attached growth for assimilation essence; break its heart to arrest that colony.

pages.title: Begin at the roots
pages.text: A book + one essence makes this journal. Discovering essence also teaches your crafting book the terminal and attunement sigil recipes.

pages.title: Begin at the roots
pages.text: The terminal is your base of operations. Bring it somewhere you can safely return.

pages.title: A place to prepare
pages.text: The first 128 blocks around Overworld world spawn are a preparation refuge: ambient hearts do not seed there and Bloom attention cools. Existing or deliberately placed infected tissue still requires care.

pages.title: A place to prepare
pages.text: Survey twice to establish a foothold, recover Deep Salvage, then face Heart of the Thicket. Its extraction liberates the Overworld and opens remote deployments. Dangerous native portals remain accessible before that point.
Your discoveries belong to you. A replacement book remembers them.
